**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

The agreement contains no most-favoured-nation mechanic in either direction. The only pricing term is the fixed 30% revenue-share on Net Sales above $11,000/month in Section 3, with no requirement that the Company extend HDI terms no less favourable than those given to third parties and no obligation to match third-party offers. Section 6.1's exclusivity/brand grant is a separate commercial restriction, properly reviewed under the exclusivity rule rather than double-flagged here. This sits at the playbook's preferred position — no MFN burdening the Company.
